## v1.13.0 — AI Integration

Integrates Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini directly into the mod. API keys are stored locally in `config/claudemc/ai.json` and never transmitted anywhere other than the chosen AI provider.

### New: AI Settings (`[AI]` in ClickGUI footer)
- Provider selector: **Anthropic (Claude)**, **OpenAI (GPT)**, **Google Gemini**
- Per-provider API key input with masked display
- Model override field (leave blank for sensible defaults: `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` / `gpt-4o-mini` / `gemini-1.5-flash`)
- Max tokens slider
- **Test Connection** button — sends a live ping to verify the key works

### New Module: SmartReply (Misc)
Replaces `AutoReply`'s hardcoded responses with AI-generated replies that sound genuinely human. Triggers on AFK-check patterns and optionally any incoming DM. Falls back to a canned response if no API key is configured. Configurable reply delay for natural timing.

### New Module: ExploitAdvisor (Misc)
Automatically collects the server fingerprint (software brand, detected plugin channels, known exploit scan results) and asks the AI to suggest specific vulnerabilities to probe — including exact commands, packet techniques, and plugin-specific CVEs. Fires automatically 6 seconds after joining (configurable) and can be manually retriggered.

### New Module: AIAssist (Misc)
Two features:
- **Chat assistant**: type `!ai <question>` in chat — the message is intercepted before it reaches the server and the AI response appears in local chat only. Prefix is configurable.
- **Packet narration**: when PacketLogger is also enabled, periodically sends the last 20 logged packets to the AI and prints a plain-English summary of what the server is doing and whether anything looks suspicious.

### Infrastructure
- `com.claudemc.ai.AIClient` — async HTTP client using Java 21 `HttpClient`, supporting all three providers with virtual-thread dispatch (never blocks the game thread)
- `com.claudemc.ai.AIConfig` — persisted config with provider/key/model settings, loaded at startup
- `AISettingsScreen` — in-game GUI for managing all AI settings without touching config files
